svg.title: The bounce, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the Lesson 2-3 activity. The robot starts in the middle of a taped circle and drives forward. While its sensor reads white, about 0.2, the program takes the else branch and keeps driving. When the sensor reaches the tape the reading jumps to 0.84, the if branch runs: the robot stops and turns 180 degrees in place, then drives straight back across the circle to the far side and bounces again. A blue line traces its path, and every bounce lands on the same line, so the robot paces back and forth across one diameter. Beside it, the outline of the test highlights the line that is running.
svg.text: if the left sensor sees a line:
Every bounce is exactly 180 degrees, so
the robot goes straight back the way it
came: it paces one line forever.
